finding: Vault Active Balance Can Underflow if claimLiabilityTotal + settlementFeeTotal Exceeds Active Balance

finding: Single-Threshold Used for All Composite Feeds - Incorrect Settlement for Multi-Feed Markets

finding: nowTs Parameter in IPriceOracle Can Be Spoofed by Callers to Bypass Staleness Checks
note: Current adapter path rejects stale data and does not allow practical spoofed freshness in this repo.

note: Dispatcher constructor disables initializers and admin checks require initialization.

finding: Composite Market Uses Single absoluteThresholdValueE8 for All Feeds - Missing Per-Feed Threshold Storage
note: Current composite implementation supports per-feed thresholds and is covered by market type tests.

finding: configInitialized Flag Not Checked in onlyAdmin Modifier - Admin Functions Callable Before Initialization
note: Initialization is protected and admin/auth paths reject uninitialized state.

finding: Oracle Cursor State Persists After Oracle Adapter Replacement, Enabling Stale Data Bypass
note: Added explicit admin recovery hook `resetOracleCursor(templateId, feedId)` after adapter swap.

finding: cancelRollingEpochWhileHalted Does Not Withdraw Yield Router Principal Before Cancellation
note: Current rolling cancel path attempts yield withdrawal before setting refund liability.

finding: Vault Active Balance Can Underflow When Yield Router Returns Less Than Principal
note: Current resolve accounting performs explicit active-vault sufficiency checks before deduction.

finding: Yield Router Deposit Approval Race Condition via forceApprove
note: Router allowance is now zeroed after each routed deposit attempt.

finding: Missing clearOhlcResult Function — Permanently Stuck Incorrect OHLC Settlement
note: `clearOhlcResult` exists in the adapter and is covered by tests.

finding: rescueToken Allows Owner to Steal StataToken Shares from All Templates
note: `rescueToken` blocks `STATA_TOKEN` alongside stake and aToken.

finding: Epoch Cancellation Blocked by Yield Router Failure - Permanent Fund Lock
note: Cancel/resolve paths use soft-failure handling with events rather than bricking lifecycle progress.

finding: Oracle Cursor Monotonicity Not Reset on Oracle Adapter Change - Stale Data Bypass
note: Same underlying cursor-reset issue; now covered by explicit admin reset flow.

finding: Vault Active Balance Can Underflow in cancelRollingEpochWhileHalted When totalPool Exceeds Active
note: Current resolve accounting performs explicit active-vault sufficiency checks before deduction.

finding: claimMany Batch DoS via Front-Running or Partial Claim State
note: `claimMany` now soft-skips already-claimed/non-claimable/zero-payout epochs instead of reverting entire batch.

finding: Residual Token Approval Left After Failed Yield Router Deposit
note: Approval is now zeroed after each routed deposit attempt, including failure paths.

finding: Reentrancy Risk in _balanceDeltaAfterWithdrawScaled via Untrusted Yield Router
note: Current external entrypoints invoking router interactions are `nonReentrant`; tested malicious-router paths are blocked or degraded safely.

finding: Uninitialized Proxy Vulnerability - configInitialized Can Be Bypassed via Module Storage Collision
note: Implementation initialization is disabled; the remaining module-collision angle is an admin/module trust issue.

finding: Manual cancel and manual resolve could proceed after yield-router shortfall, leaving claims underfunded or funds operationally stuck
note: Manual lifecycle now requires full routed-principal recovery before cancel/resolve can complete when router principal is involved.

finding: Rolling cancel while halted could proceed without full principal recovery
note: Halted rolling cancel now enforces full principal recovery before refund-mode cancellation.

finding: Yield-router replacement was possible while routed principal was still outstanding
note: Router replacement is blocked until outstanding routed principal is fully reconciled.

finding: Reconcile path could blind-book routed principal without proving recovered funds existed in-engine
note: Reconciliation now consumes only actual unreconciled recovered balances.

finding: Emergency withdraw trusted router-reported returns instead of engine token balance delta
note: Emergency recovery now accounts by engine balance delta, preventing liar-router credit inflation.

finding: Emergency recovery and routed-principal reconciliation were callable outside an explicit paused recovery window
note: Both admin recovery operations are now pause-gated.

finding: Same-template operations could continue while unreconciled recovery was still pending
note: Pending recovery now blocks new user ops and rolling round execution until full reconcile.

finding: Disabled yield router could still receive fresh routed deposits
note: Deposit routing is now blocked once the router enters disabled state.

finding: Disabled/failure state could be reset live, re-enabling an unhealthy router mid-operation
note: Failure-state reset is now pause-gated and same-router replacement no longer clears disabled state.

finding: Manual resolve and rolling recovery could still attempt settlement through a disabled router while principal remained routed
note: Settlement/cancel recovery now rejects disabled-router paths with outstanding routed principal.

finding: Protocol could unpause into known-bad disabled-router or unreconciled-recovery state
note: Unpause is now blocked until router-disabled and unreconciled-recovery conditions are cleared.

finding: Excess recovered yield from emergency unwind remained as unaccounted engine balance
note: Excess recovered balance is now booked to fee reserves after full principal reconcile.

finding: Cross-template emergency withdraw misattribution could book another template's stranded principal into the wrong fee reserve and allow unsafe recovery progression
note: Excess recovered balance is no longer auto-booked while any routed principal remains globally outstanding; operators can explicitly reassign recovered balance to the correct template and then reconcile/finalize safely.

finding: Global `yieldFeeBps` could be changed mid-epoch and retroactively alter payouts for already-open manual or rolling epochs
note: Each epoch now snapshots the yield fee at open, so later admin fee updates affect only future epochs.

finding: Emergency recovery admin flows allowed invalid destination templates, creating an operator path to blackhole recovered funds into unwithdrawable fee buckets
note: Recovery admin functions now validate initialized destination templates before emergency withdraw/finalize/reassignment can route balances into them.

finding: Trusted-reporter clear operations allowed stale same-type signatures to be replayed immediately after owner correction
note: Per-market nonces are now included in lock/resolve/OHLC signed payloads and incremented on clear so pre-clear signatures cannot be replayed.

finding: Trusted-reporter correction flow allowed stale cross-type signatures to be replayed after clearing the opposite resolution path
note: Clearing scalar resolve now also invalidates stale OHLC signatures for the same market, and clearing OHLC also invalidates stale scalar resolve signatures.

finding: Rotating the trusted reporter back to a previous key could revive old signatures from before the first rotation
note: Signed payloads now include a global reporter epoch that increments on every reporter rotation, invalidating all pre-rotation signatures.

finding: Rolling lifecycle could be reset while the halted active epoch or previous locked epoch was still uncleared
note: Reset now requires the halted active epoch and adjacent predecessor to be cleared first.

finding: resetOracleCursor was callable during an active epoch, allowing live oracle continuity override
note: Cursor reset now reverts while the template's active epoch is still `Open` or `Locked`.

finding: Oracle adapter replacement could change settlement source for already-open epochs
note: Each epoch now snapshots the concrete oracle adapter address at open; rolling execution halts if adjacent epochs would require mixing snapshots through one shared sample.

finding: Trusted-reporter clear operations lacked settlement-correction events, reducing operator visibility
note: Clear paths now emit events for correction observability.

finding: Dispatcher module storage-compatibility marker can be spoofed by malicious allowlisted bytecode, enabling delegatecall storage corruption
note: This is a real exploit path only after trusted admin allowlists/registers malicious module bytecode; it is not an unprivileged bug, but it remains a production-grade governance/module-onboarding risk intrinsic to the current modular architecture.

finding: Centralized admin can rewire modules, replace routers/oracles, and upgrade the dispatcher, so operational security is equivalent to privileged custody
note: Intended by design for this deployment model; not a code bug, but launch readiness still depends on multisig discipline, upgrade controls, module artifact verification, and operational runbooks.
